risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (381.76) with imminent FOMC event (1 day) creates severe near-term volatility risk; utilities defensive characteristics offer limited protection in acute panic conditions.

debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term trend structure (supertrend, EMA 50/200 bullish, price above 200-EMA) combined with extreme market fear (33/100) creates contrarian accumulation opportunity near support at 22.9848.
debate.key_bear_argument: Imminent FOMC event (1 day) with VIX crisis regime (381.76), negative short-term momentum (MACD, RSI, price below EMA 9/21), Bollinger Band squeeze at lower band, zero fundamental support, and high earnings risk (29 days) make this a dangerous swing entry timing.
